<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that breaks a nitro group and forms a primary amine. I will use the product SMILES that contains the sulfonamide (the amine already attached to the sulfonyl group) as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(NS(=O)(=O)c3ccc(F)Cl)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
